messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: HIGH - unusual auth token exfil pattern detected from edge-authz-proxy in us-west-2. Signatures match previous small leak. Pager: @maria (sec-oncall). Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/edge/4999999999

maria (sec-oncall): I'm on it. spiking tokens with same user-agent + odd x-forwarded-for patterns. Pulling recent request bundle now. Can someone check if any customer-facing requests returned 200 with token payloads?

dan (eng-oncall): Looking. Quick check against request logs -> a few 200s where body contains base64 blob that looks like truncated header. Pushing grep now.

dan (eng-oncall): snippet from edge logs: ```
2026-03-18T15:12:03Z edge-authz-proxy request_id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/infer status=200 user_agent="okhttp/4.9.0" x-forwarded-for=10.23.5.12 body="{\"input\":\"...\",\"meta\":\"eyJhbGciOiAi...\"}"
2026-03-18T15:12:07Z edge-authz-proxy request_id=def456 method=POST path=/v1/infer status=204 user_agent="curl/7.79.1" x-forwarded-for=54.210.3.9 body=""
```

maria (sec-oncall): That base64 looks like jwt fragments. Need to treat as exposed auth header. Any indication of S3 or external forwarding?

oliver (infra): Data plane telemetry shows a flurry of outbound connections from staging-logforwarder around 15:10-15:20 to an external IP range (AS-62211). Investigating whether logs were forwarded accidentally.

janet (customer-success): Any customer impact? Do we need to open an incident bridge with affected customers?

maria (sec-oncall): Unknown yet. Dan, can you grep for responses to external 3rd-party IPs and list affected tenants? Prioritize prod orgs. I'll prepare rotation plan once we confirm token types.

dan (eng-oncall): Quick tenant mapping shows 3 org IDs with activity: org_82, org_211, org_77. org_82 had 4 requests that contained token fragments. No immediate errors reported by customers yet.

maria (sec-oncall): OK. Action items: 1) Rotate service token used by edge-authz-proxy and staging-logforwarder (oliver) 2) Reconfigure logforwarder to block external sinks until we validate (oliver) 3) Notify CS for orgs (janet) 4) Legal on standby (tess) 5) Run targeted reissue for user sessions in org_82 (deploy-bot -> dan to trigger) 6) Collect full payloads for forensics (dan).

oliver (infra): Starting rotation of staging-logforwarder creds now. ETA ~6m. Reconfiguring sink to internal-only. Will also add iptables deny rule for the external AS range.

maria (sec-oncall): @tess can you advise on customer notification language if we confirm token snippets leaked? Need to know if we escalate to data-privacy notification.

tess (legal): I'll join the bridge and review. If tokens are partial and short-lived we may not be required to notify yet, but preserve timeline and scope. Please tag any PII hits.

dan (eng-oncall): Collected payloads and uploaded to secure evidence bucket at s3://redwood-sec-evidence/4999999999/ (access restricted). Commands used: ```
aws s3 cp /tmp/payloads/ s3://redwood-sec-evidence/4999999999/ --recursive --acl private
```

maria (sec-oncall): Good. @oliver post confirmation here when rotation complete. Also add a temporary WAF rule to block the suspicious UA and XFF combos.

oliver (infra): Rotation done for staging-logforwarder creds and sink locked down. WAF rule deployed to edge route. Added host deny for 54.210.3.9/32 and AS-62211 range.

maria (sec-oncall): Thanks. Next: run session reissue for org_82 and org_211, revoke any active tokens older than 24h, and run a scan for similar base64 patterns across prod logs for last 72h. Dan and deploy-bot please coordinate the runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: token-reissue-job-4999999999 queued, estimated runtime 8m.

dan (eng-oncall): Reissue job started. I'll annotate the bridge with progress and results.

janet (customer-success): I'll draft initial customer note: "We detected unusual auth token fragments in logs and are rotating keys and reviewing. No confirmed misuse yet. We'll update within 4 hours." Sharing draft in #customer-notifications when ready.

maria (sec-oncall): Bridge established: https://meet.redwood.example/bridge/4999999999. We will escalate to Incident Commander if we find confirmed exfil with clear tokens. For now treat as P1 potential data exposure. Keep this thread for runbook updates only. :white_check_mark:
